Original definitions and examples · Printed book page numbers ·

One correct answer per word counts in each session: morning 00:00–11:59, afternoon 12:00–17:59, evening 18:00–23:59 (device local time). Three consecutive correct sessions turn green. A wrong answer resets the streak and schedules a review for the next day. Clearing site data removes progress; export a backup regularly.

About KK pronunciation

American pronunciations are displayed in KK notation, converted from ipa-dict / CMUdict, with supplemental entries. Phrase pronunciations are assembled word by word; connected speech and word stress can vary. KK uses [e] and [o] for the vowels often written /eɪ/ and /oʊ/ in IPA. See data license.

Install & use offline

Wait for “Ready for offline use” before disconnecting.

  • Chrome / Edge: Use the browser menu → Install app (or Install this site as an app).
  • iPhone / iPad: Open in Safari → Share → Add to Home Screen → Open as Web App.
  • In-app browsers: Open this link in a full browser first.

Words, definitions, examples, Traditional Chinese translations and KK pronunciations work offline. Audio depends on voices available on your device. Progress stays in this browser; export a backup before switching browsers.
